# token-build

On-demand reference adapted from the vendored MIT UI/UX Kit. Project policy
and frontend-design govern scope and completion.

Use for a requested token pipeline change. Identify the real source format,
consumers, generation command, and committed outputs. Reuse the toolchain.
Keep one authoritative input and deterministic requested outputs; regenerate
only affected targets and check drift. Ordinary styling does not require
Style Dictionary, Figma sync, new platform outputs, or new CI.
